srpc.def: The short-run Phillips curve: a downward-sloping curve showing the short-run trade-off between the inflation rate and the unemployment rate. A change in AD moves the economy along it.

lrpc.def: The long-run Phillips curve: a vertical line at the natural rate of unemployment, showing that in the long run unemployment returns to the natural rate whatever the inflation rate.

expected-inflation.def: The inflation rate households and firms expect, which they build into wages and prices. A rise in expected inflation shifts the SRPC right; the SRPC crosses LRPC at the expected rate.
